metadata.title: Instability and Morse Index of Exponentially Subelliptic Harmonic Maps
metadata.abstract: Let $M$ be a closed manifold with a bracket-generating distribution $H$. We study the Morse index of exponentially subelliptic harmonic maps. After establishing finiteness, we estimate the index through two test spaces. The extrinsic one averages the index form over projected ambient parallel frames, reducing the estimate to a trace identity involving an extrinsic scalar with a quartic exponential term. The intrinsic one uses parallel sections of the pullback bundle, on which the index form descends to a coupled quadratic form that is exact when a global parallel frame exists. The bounds apply to round spheres, products of spheres, and convex hypersurfaces. On a closed Heisenberg nilmanifold, the intrinsic reduction yields a spectral formula for the index.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 次椭圆调和映射指标估计
analysis.workSummary: 对闭流形上括号生成分布的指数次椭圆调和映射证明指标有限，并用外在平行标架投影与拉回丛平行截面获得两类估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 在 Heisenberg 例上把内在约化具体化为谱公式。
analysis.limitations: 精确内在公式要求全局平行标架；一般对象只获界。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 为亚黎曼变分映射提供稳定性计算工具。
